scope: Installed test-only patched Bun, supervised native arm64-v8a application-process probes; not the experimental plugin's AutoJs6 Binder contract.
sourceBinding: Built from this base plus the exact 17 UTF-8/LF source inputs recorded below; the build was not falsely attributed to the unmodified base commit. Inputs were revalidated after all device runs.

historicalFailure.scope: Old unsupervised Java path: two rounds of 10/12 on each of the same four devices. Preserved as failed historical evidence, not relabeled as passing.

timingPolicy.terminationToExitMillis: Monotonic time from control-pipe termination request to confirmed supervisor wait completion.
timingPolicy.elapsedMillis: Monotonic launch-to-exit-and-stream-drain measurement; exact private workspace removal is asserted separately.
timingPolicy.readiness: All three lifecycle fixtures register an ignoring SIGTERM handler before printing a complete newline-terminated PID marker. The app verifies both process UIDs, command paths and the child -> supervisor -> instrumentation parent chain before requesting termination.
timingPolicy.pidUse: PIDs are observations for parentage and disappearance only; only control-pipe EOF requests termination. No PID-directed signal is sent by the Java probe.

limitations: The complete experimental plugin/Binder integration was not exercised. The official plugin's separate 2026-09-08 Binder evidence cannot substitute for it.
Only API 28, 31, 33 and 35 native arm64 with 4096-byte pages were exercised. API 29/30/32 and native x86_64 still need execution evidence.

The x86_64 test APK was built and statically verified, not installed. No 16 KiB environment was used in this session; native arm64 16 KiB remains untested and the known x86_64 large-page block remains.
Successful startup and spawn tests do not prove every syscall fallback or CLOSE_RANGE_CLOEXEC/FD isolation semantic. Forced traps, blocked SIGSYS masks and watch/reload remain outstanding.
The supervisor manages its immediate Bun child only, not arbitrary detached descendants, and is not a security sandbox.
Only this invocation's isolated test-only package was force-stopped and uninstalled. No official plugin installation, AVD or shared Android setting was changed.
Technical source/APK/runtime/helper validation is not a legal opinion or release approval; distributionReady remains false until the separate experimental distribution gates are satisfied.
